description: This is a modern L-shaped sectional sofa with a chaise lounge on the left side. The sofa features plush seating and back cushions upholstered in a light grey, subtly textured fabric. It includes several large back cushions and a few smaller square throw pillows, all in matching grey fabric. The base of the sofa is a darker grey or black, providing a clean contrast and a sturdy foundation. The design is sleek and minimalist, emphasizing comfort and functionality with its clean lines and ample seating.
